routes.label: registration under the National Identity Registration Act

note: Kiribati's National Identity Registration Act (2018) established a national ID system, operating since 2019 and issued as a smartcard, not mandatory and not covering children; the World Bank notes limited take-up because of a high fee and the cards' expiry (SEAP digital ID overview). The fee, the term and the time weren't found.

sources.title: Institute on Statelessness and Inclusion / SEAP, Digital ID overview: Kiribati
sources.said: In 2018, Kiribati passed legislation to establish a national identity system, ... which began operating in 2019 and marked the onset of a national ID system in the country. ... According to the World Bank, its utilization remains limited due to persistent administrative barriers related to the high fee as well as an expiry period for the cards.
